title: The RSVP and Event Management WordPress plugin before 2.7.19 does not escape a submitted value before outputting it…
description: The RSVP and Event Management WordPress plugin versions before 2.7.19 contain a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This occurs because the plugin does not properly escape a submitted value before outputting it back in the RSVP form after a failed submission. The vulnerability could be exploited against high-privilege users such as administrators.
